name: c588-repack
title: Ryan Shea's #588 certificate with a pad-optimal 5,009-bank table and a fourth-order rate lemma (x-pack B-quartic)
statement: OpenAI's UniformFourier statement (DFT of every length and convolution), only the exponent and seven names changed

compared_with.what: Ryan Shea's Lean-checked record on the same certificate

mode_note: REPLACES 38 of Shea's generated files (bank table, rate, Fourier chain, challenges) and adds Work/BlockAccounting/Moment4.lean; the names keep Shea's suffix C588. Apply it to its own copy of the tree, never to the tree of c588m.

comparator.note: fourier.json is Shea's own configuration, byte-identical to his tree's (sha256 2906700b...); fourier-neg.json is the negative configuration that ran, re-made byte for byte from its text in logs/colab/cp-cmp-all.log (sha256 dc945246..., the hash printed there)

checks.what: 40 modules rebuilt from source on a copy of Shea's built tree
one unit stronger: RESULT: FAIL, as it must
official comparator with Shea's configuration: nanoda and Lean kernels accept (jail2.sh stand-in)

an independent agent re-checked the built tree, mounted read-only: lake build --no-build is up to date (9,278 jobs); the three theorems depend on the standard axioms and the exponent is 1 - 12383291/10^10 (probe-main.log, probe-chal.log); Compare.lean RESULT: PASS (compare-pos.log). It did not repeat the comparator. INCIDENT-mathlib-deleted.txt and restore.log record how its first attempt (vcp.log) deleted the tree's Mathlib copy and how it was restored before these runs. report.txt is its written verdict
the same agent's Compare.lean one unit stronger was still running when it stopped; compare-neg.log is empty. The negative control of the build itself is compare-negative above
